scope: read-only structural asset audit; visual review remains with root

baseline.reason: Concurrent client1.59 preparation has migrated local 012 registry. Freeze committed published1.58; list approved candidate separately.

summary.topologyScreenResult: Screened main body meshes show no open/overconnected edges at 1e-6 local weld tolerance (the old012 label mesh grouped under Jar is excluded as a label). 24 dip-tube/pipette meshes likewise show no boundary/overconnected edges. This does not measure real wall thickness.

separateCandidates.status: Published client1.59 after frozen audit baseline; see postBaselineUpdate
separateCandidates.countedAsFormal: not in frozen1.58 table; formal in1.59 update

method: Read every registered GLB JSON/BIN, all scenes including080 finishes, mesh and material associations, nested root parenting, texture headers, primitive/accessor counts.
SHA256 every32 model against committed baseline manifest, and locate/hash every source.blend. Source was not reopened in Blender.

For selected body/label/tube meshes, read POSITION and indices; weld local positions to1e-6 then count boundary/overconnected edges. This screens open surfaces, not physical wall thickness or manufacturability.
Trace runtime castShadow/receiveShadow overrides from baseline code. Do not equate a marker with a rendered shadow.
Compare every model hash with previous32-model audit and enumerate actual historical pose/finish records. No fresh browser screenshots created or visually evaluated by this agent.
limitations: All forms are display-level inferred packaging, not measured CAD. Topological closure and source existence do not establish material realism or wall thickness.

Reference photographs, screenshots, metadata flags, test pass counts, and file names alone cannot prove visual quality. The root visual review is required before claiming all models meet the new standard.
This report does not recheck live service or rerun Blender renders; uses published1.58 commit and local assets plus saved publication/QA evidence.
Legacy material conversion uses approximate WebGL nested transparency; path-traced Blender renders do not guarantee same browser appearance.

Old unified poses are desktop historical evidence;080 after/baby lacked historical poses; root has now supplied new four-pose files for both, see update. No actual mobile-device validation is claimed.
All-model rawGLB mesh counts differ from state.meshes: latter is renderer.info.render.calls, and state.triangles is submitted render triangles.

focused061Check.interpretation: No extra black quad/material in bottle region or opaque-black label bitmap. A reported transient black square needs controlled browser reproduction; no asset mutation recommended from structure alone.
focused061Check.rootRecheckOutcome: Root reported black square disappeared after half-expand and return to closed; saved recheck. Record as first-frame transient pending reproducibility, not permanent model failure.
